senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="N00954">same</cite> <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:7">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 11:2">Gen. XI, 2</cite>) <he>נַסְעוּ מן מדינחא וכ׳</he> they moved from the east to go further east.
to remove. Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ top אנא מסתכל ולא מַסַּע דעתי I can look (at the priests) without diverting my attention (from my prayers); Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ מַסְּעָה; v. הֶסֵּעַ.
